apps_sub: Applications per prequalification cycle. Open one, enter the 0–3 rubric scores — the result recomputes instantly with the Rev4 formulas.
att_exp: documents expired or expiring within 60 days
cats_note: Category assignments are illustrative — in production the vendor selects and the manager confirms.
err_bad_request: The request could not be understood.
err_conflict: This conflicts with the current state.
err_forbidden: You don't have access to do this.
err_rate_limited: Too many attempts — wait a moment and try again.
err_unsupported_media_type: This file type is not accepted.
ev_sub: Raw indicators arrive from the vendor form automatically; 0–3 rubric cells are filled after document verification.
foot: Prototype · Rev4 scoring model · Data from TQS2026006 prequalification
in_api_d: Adapters for 1C, SAP, Odoo and custom REST — turnover, headcount and project lists refresh automatically.
in_excel_d: Reads the existing 11-sheet application form, maps fields to codes (A.1…G.7), checks the document list.
in_form_d: Same field catalogue; the vendor enters data with validation and document upload.
in_perf_d: Post-award performance (time, quality, HSE) — feeds re-qualification scores.
in_reg_d: Automatic check of tax clearance and licence status (planned).
in_sub: Vendor data arrives three ways: the Excel form (current process), the portal form, and API from the vendor's ERP. Every field keeps its source and timestamp.
in_try_d: Reads the WESA form file and shows how fields were mapped.
in_w1: A.16 certificate date 2020-09-28 — does not meet the 3-month rule, verify
in_w2: C.t2 ongoing project completion given in two formats (0.95 and 85%) — normalised
login_staff_sub: E-mail and password, then the authenticator code.
login_vendor_sub: Enter the e-mail your company is registered with — a one-time code will be sent.
m_none: No prequalified vendor in this category — market research needed.
m_rec_cond: Source additional vendors for weak packages, or proceed with a logged risk.
m_rec_go: Vendor base is sufficient to enter the tender.
m_rec_nogo: Critical packages have no vendor — entering without market research is risky.
m_rule: Rule: package GO — ≥2 class A/B vendors with capacity fit (largest project ≥ 40% of package value); CONDITIONAL — ≥1 qualified vendor; NO-GO — none. Project: all packages GO → GO; any NO-GO → NO-GO; otherwise CONDITIONAL.
mk_sub: The vendor base by category, capacity, certification and data quality.
mo_sub: Versioned criteria sets. The subcontractor model equals TQS2026006 Rev4; the supplier model is a proposal.
no_prequalified_vendor: No prequalified vendor in this category
ov_sub: State of the vendor base, pending applications and items needing attention.
proj_sub: Matching vendors per work package, coverage and the go / no-go indicator.
register_sub: Create your company's account — a one-time code will confirm the e-mail.
staff_totp_sub: Enter the 6-digit code from the authenticator app.
tl1: Shield — ERP API sync: turnover and headcount refreshed
tl5: Arti Qrup — A-05 tax clearance expired
va_sub: Sections A–G of the existing Excel form. Yellow cells are filled by the vendor; the purple code is the required document.
vd_sub: Upload each document as a PDF. Applications without mandatory documents are not accepted.
vendors_sub: One vendor base fed from every source (Excel form, portal, ERP API). Click a row.
vh_class_txt: Classes: A (90+) invited first priority, B (80–89) invited, C (70–79) conditionally invited.
vh_n1: Renew your tax clearance certificate (3-month rule).
vh_n2: ISO 9001 certificate expires 10.12.2026 — upload the renewed copy.
vh_n3: Confirm your profile data once a year.
vh_sub: Where you are in the prequalification process and what comes next.
vp_sub: Stored once for all tenders — no need to re-enter it every time.
vs_c3: Mandatory criteria (licence, tax clearance, HSE) answered “Yes”
vs_decl: I, the undersigned, confirm that this form and all attached documents are true and accurate.
vs_sent: Application submitted — now under commission review
vs_sub: With the director's confirmation the application goes to the commission.
